lines.ref: “Why are you always studying in the library?”
lines.guide: A question someone asks you about a habit, in quotes. Conversation-meme setup.

lines.ref: Me when I'm studying at home:
lines.guide: 'Me when I'm <doing it> at <the other place>:' The punchline is the picture.

shots.brief: Doing the habit properly and focused: working/studying at a desk or laptop, tripod, static, medium-wide.
The funny failure version: stands up, stretches arms up, flops face-down onto the bed / couch. Tripod, wide, static. Needs a visible action payoff.
